title: Back to the Classroom at 67

pre.en: Who got the better mark in the first maths test?
pre.zh: 第一次数学测验谁考得更好？

intro: 一段地方新闻播报：越来越多的成年人回学校读书。播报先给数字，再讲两个人的故事，引一句院长的话，最后用一件趣事收尾。读的时候留意 should have / could have done：should have 说「本该做却没做」的后悔，could have 说「当时本来有可能」的另一条路。结尾一句话很有劲。

sentences.en: Now, some good news for anyone thinking of going back to college.
sentences.zh: 下面这条好消息，送给正在考虑回学校读书的各位。

sentences.en: The number of students over thirty at Northfield College has gone up by eighteen per cent in two years, according to new figures.
sentences.zh: 最新数据显示，北田学院三十岁以上的学生人数两年里涨了百分之十八。

sentences.en: Evening classes in coding, Spanish and A-level maths were full by August.
sentences.zh: 编程、西班牙语和 A-level 数学的夜校班，八月份就报满了。

sentences.en: One of those students is Pauline Hall, a sixty-seven-year-old retired bus driver.
sentences.zh: 其中一位学生是 Pauline Hall，今年六十七岁，是位退休的公交车司机。

sentences.en: She enrolled on an A-level maths course last September, a few months after her husband had died.
sentences.zh: 去年九月，丈夫去世几个月后，她报了 A-level 数学课。

sentences.en: "I should have done this years ago," she told us.
sentences.zh: 「我早该这么做了，」她对我们说。

sentences.en: "I could have gone to university, but I left school at sixteen because my family needed the money."
sentences.zh: 「我本来可以上大学的，可家里缺钱，我十六岁就不上学了。」

sentences.en: For forty years, she got by with a calculator and a good memory.
sentences.zh: 四十年来，她就靠一个计算器和一副好记性对付过来。

sentences.en: First, she took the course for a test drive at a free taster evening.
sentences.zh: 她先去参加了一个免费的体验晚课，试了试这门课。

sentences.en: "It's like breaking in new shoes," she said.
sentences.zh: 「就像穿新鞋，」她说。

sentences.en: "It hurts for a month, then it fits.
sentences.zh: 「头一个月磨脚，之后就合脚了。

sentences.en: I still get half the homework wrong, but at least now I know why."
sentences.zh: 作业我还是错一半，不过至少现在我知道错在哪儿了。」

sentences.en: Dev Mistry, who's thirty-four, dropped out of university in 2012 after a year of computer science.
sentences.zh: Dev Mistry 今年三十四岁，2012 年读了一年计算机专业后就退了学。

sentences.en: These days he works night shifts at a warehouse to pay the rent.
sentences.zh: 现在他在一家仓库上夜班，挣钱交房租。

sentences.en: He fits his coding course in around them.
sentences.zh: 编程课就挤在夜班的空当里上。

sentences.en: "I shouldn't have given up so easily," he said.
sentences.zh: 「当初我不该那么轻易就放弃，」他说。

sentences.en: "If I'd stayed, I'd have finished in 2015.
sentences.zh: 「要是坚持下来，2015 年我就毕业了。

sentences.en: Now I stick to a simple plan: two hours every morning, after my shift and before bed."
sentences.zh: 现在我就守着一个简单的计划：每天早上学两个小时，下了夜班、睡觉之前。」

sentences.en: "Most of our adult students want a second chance, not a certificate," said the college director, Sunita Rao.
sentences.zh: 「我们大多数成年学生想要的是第二次机会，而不是一张证书，」学院院长 Sunita Rao 说。

sentences.en: "But in the long run, a lot of them get both.
sentences.zh: 「不过从长远看，很多人两样都拿到了。

sentences.en: It's never too late to start, and I think the numbers will keep rising."
sentences.zh: 什么时候开始都不晚，我觉得人数还会继续涨。」

sentences.en: And finally, Pauline's grandson Connor, who's seventeen, is in the same maths class.
sentences.zh: 最后还有一件事：Pauline 的孙子 Connor 今年十七岁，跟她在同一个数学班。

sentences.en: He thought he'd beat her easily.
sentences.zh: 他原以为能轻松考过奶奶。

sentences.en: In the first test, she got 81 per cent.
sentences.zh: 第一次测验，她考了 81%。

sentences.en: He got 74.
sentences.zh: 他考了 74%。

sentences.en: "He should have revised," she said.
sentences.zh: 「他该好好复习的，」她说。

sentences.en: Her test paper is now on display on the fridge.
sentences.zh: 她的试卷现在正贴在冰箱上，供全家参观。

cards.note: to start studying again at a college after a long time away from education
cards.tip: 英国的 college 常指继续教育学院（成人、职业和 A-level 课程），和 university 不同；college 前面不加 the。
cards.example: After ten years in sales, she decided to go back to college and study nursing.

cards.note: figure 在报道里常是「数字」，复数 figures；sales figures 销售数据。
动词 retire，名词 retirement。
to officially join a course so that you can study on it
cards.tip: 英式拼写 enrol（一个 l），但 enrolled、enrolling 双写 l；英式用 on，美式说 enroll in。
cards.example: I've enrolled on an evening course in photography.

cards.note: to manage to live or do something with the money or things you have
cards.tip: 靠什么应付用 with / on：get by with a little French、get by on £50 a week。
cards.example: I don't speak much French, but I can get by.

cards.note: 动词 calculate（计算）。

cards.text: take sth for a test drive
cards.note: to drive a car before you buy it to see if you like it
cards.tip: 本义是买车前试驾（第 70 课），这里借来说「先试听一下课」，带点幽默。
cards.example: Take the app for a test drive before you pay for it.

cards.note: 英式说法：a taster session / class，先免费体验一次。
to wear new shoes for short periods until they become comfortable
to make a mistake about something, for example a time, a place or a fact
cards.tip: sth 放在 get 和 wrong 中间：get half the homework wrong。
cards.example: I always get her name wrong.

cards.note: to leave a school, university or course before you have finished it
cards.tip: 名词 dropout 是「退学的人」；不说 drop out from。
cards.example: He dropped out of his law course after six months.

cards.note: ware 是「货物」，house 是「房子」，合起来就是放货的地方。
to find time to do something or see someone
cards.tip: 围着什么安排用 around：fit sth in around work；英式过去式常用 fitted。
cards.example: The doctor is busy, but she can fit you in at four.

cards.note: to keep doing what you planned or promised, even when it is difficult

cards.zh: 第二次机会；重来的机会
cards.note: an opportunity to try something again after you failed or missed it the first time
cards.tip: 常和 give、get、deserve 连用：give sb a second chance。

cards.note: 重音在第二个音节：cer-TI-fi-cate。
after a long period of time, in the future
used to say that you can still do something, even if you are older or it seems late
cards.tip: 后面接动词原形；也可以单说一句：It's never too late!
cards.example: It's never too late to learn to swim.

cards.note: 英式意思是「复习」，美式多说 review / study；revise 也有「修改」的意思。
put in a public place so that people can see it
